summary: 10.0.35.01 Enterprise Release - Full Parity Fixes for Data Import Loaders DTO Contracts, Reporting KPI Cards & Saved Views 2-Way Persistence, Settings 5 Lifetime Database Business Assets, Master Lookup Edit, Permission Matrix Optimistic Locking, and Address Interlocking
highlights: 1. Data Import Studio 8 Loaders: Restored full Java 17+ record DTO contracts (id: null, rowVersion: 0L, full primitive fields) across all 8 loaders. Added createItem/updateItem split in Item Master with automatic duplicate conflict recovery matching Desktop ImportService.

2. Reporting KPI Cards: Replaced plain text KPI boxes in Tab 1 (6 metrics) and Tab 4 (4 metrics) with 84px horizontal cards featuring 34x34px rounded icon badges, trend pills, bold 16px values, and action notes matching Desktop ReportsController.

3. Saved Reports 2-Way Workflow: Implemented server-side persistence in saveCurrentReportConfig() via POST /api/support/saved-views (screen='REPORT_CENTER', data='REPORT_V2:...'), Tab 3 Saved Reports Catalog table, and instant filter restoration into Report Viewer.

4. Scheduled Reports Dropdown: Fixed Saved Report select in New Schedule modal to query opt.name and opt.title/opt.reportId from server SavedReportOption record, completely eliminating undefined values.
5. Report Viewer Dynamic Filters: Added configureFilterVisibility() based on ReportDefinition.supportedFilters to conditionally display relevant filters per report type.
6. Report Favorites Synchronization: Unified report favorites cross-platform sync with POST/GET /api/support/saved-views (screen='REPORT_FAVORITES', name='__favorites__').
7. Address Interlocking: Enforced live readonly attribute and automatic mirroring from billing address/GSTIN to delivery address/GSTIN in Sales and Purchase when Same as Billing is checked.
8. Fast Item Line Entry: Expanded autocomplete item search bar to full toolbar width and eliminated redundant select dropdown in Sales Creation.
9. Master Lookup Edit: Fixed LookupDto contract (lookupType, displayOrder, sanitized numeric id, rowVersion) in MasterDataController.js, preventing HTTP 500 Jackson deserialization crashes.

10. Permission Matrix Optimistic Locking: Updated ReportService to call /api/admin/permissions/set?role= and tracked rowVersion in UserAccessController.js, eliminating HTTP 409 ConcurrentEditException.

11. Settings 5 Business Assets Lifetime DB Storage: Centralized all 5 branding assets (App Banner, Mark, Logo, Seal, Payment QR) in PostgreSQL server_resource table via /api/authority/resources/BUSINESS_ASSET/{key} with authenticated blob resolution and real-time dimension badges.
